TITLE: LockByte App
DESCRIPTION: As a first-year student, I had the incredible opportunity to participate in my college's 7th International Conference, showcasing my project: LockByte. This advanced encryption and decryption application is designed to securely protect various types of files, including videos, images, text documents, and Word files. LockByte employs the robust AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) algorithm, along with password protection, for both encryption and decryption processes, ensuring that sensitive information remains safe and confidential.
